name: watch-button
title: Watch button
description: A watch button with levels: all activity, mentions only or nothing, as a split button whose words and bell always say what you will be told.
docs: Controlled: keep level and count in state and update both in onLevelChange once the request has succeeded. The main button switches between the last level that was on and "ignore"; the chevron opens a radio menu. Pass levels to change the words (id must stay all, mentions or ignore) and subject for the accessible name ("Watching this issue, all activity"). The count moves by one when watching starts or stops. A rejected onLevelChange rolls everything back with a message.
